name: Caslon Cuts 1841
designer: Individual engravers unidentified in the specimen
description: Pictorial engravings, heraldic cuts, chess pieces, framed labels, pointing hands and incidental illustrations from the H. Caslon specimen of 1841.
observed: 201 complete historical designs. Source inventory records distinct engravings, repeated impressions, assembled settings and existing canonical designs.
reconstructed: No invented pictorial content. Recorded exclusions remove neighbouring sorts, captions and isolated scan specks. Measured rotation and recorded quadrilateral corrections straighten scan geometry; uniform scaling preserves historical proportions.
